notes: «قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا» is a change of verb only: the three co-transmitters are one level, one group
«فقلت لابن عباس» is the transmitter asking inside the story; he is in the scene and is not added as a link. The last link is Ibn Abbas, whose answer is part of the saying
«ولم يقل أبو كريب مرجأ» is a wording remark and is left out
